name: Call of Water
summary: You carry the Shard of Water back to Islen Waterseer along the Barrens coast. Your journey proves your harmony with restorative energies and earns you a Water Totem.

sections.title: A Long Journey Home
sections.body: You carry a gift from the Minor Manifestation of Water back across the sea. To earn it, you crossed continents to the tainted shores of Silverpine Forest and faced the corruption there. Water gives life, adapts, and heals, yet its pliant nature leaves it open to blight and dark magic. Before the Minor Manifestation, you witnessed pure elemental will and received the Shard of Water. Now, as you return to the sun-scorched Barrens, the shard reminds you that water connects distant corners of the world.

sections.title: The Water Totem
sections.body: When you give Islen Waterseer the shard, she weighs more than proof of your journey. She tests whether you have learned the balance between preservation and renewal. Lordaeron's spreading rot can hide small victories, yet cleansing even one wellspring matters to the spirits. Islen recognizes your offering and gives you a Water Totem. Through it, you can channel cleansing, healing, and mana-restoring streams into the mortal realm, binding you to the tide.

faq.q: What is the Shard of Water?
faq.answer: The Shard of Water is an elemental remnant given by the Minor Manifestation of Water. It shows that you understand water's life-giving power and have opposed the corruption threatening elemental streams.

faq.q: Where do I take the Shard of Water?
faq.answer: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer at her secluded camp on the Barrens' eastern shore, south of Ratchet.

faq.q: What do I receive for completing this trial?
faq.answer: You receive a Water Totem, the conduit shamans need to call water-based elemental totems for healing and restorative magic.

faq.q: Why was the trial set in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Silverpine Forest's waters suffer heavy corruption from plague and shadow magic. There, you witnessed water's fragility and defended its natural purity against decay.
Islen Waterseer is a tauren shaman at the Barrens' eastern coast. She oversees the shamanic trials of water and teaches initiates to commune with fluid spirits and master restorative arts.

angles.text: As a shaman, you receive your Water Totem and gain the restorative wellsprings and cleansing fountains central to your role as a spiritual healer.
As a member of the Horde, you share responsibility for the spirits of the land. Young shamans are called to cleanse blighted lands across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
